what: Dozens of objects (basic shapes in white clay, chrome and skin colors, plus image plates) surround a swollen central hub in a zero-gravity cylinder (axis = Horizontal, radius = half the plate height, side walls) — they float confined by cannon-es physics while an orthographic camera circles the cylinder. The spin force starts at .01 and is added to by the wheel (−Δ/800, within ±.5, every 30ms) and vertical drag (distance moved/1000, touch /10, within ±.3). It decays by .98 each frame and settles at ±.01, so it always turns slowly (one lap = 10). While pressed, all objects are pulled each frame toward the cursor (screen coords −1~1), and on release they scatter, each with ±15 impulse per axis. Each object receives a small force orbiting the cylinder (.02, 10s period), and white objects occasionally flash to chrome (metalness 1 · roughness .1) by ((1+sin(.4t+index))/2)^5 and then return. The hub always faces the camera. At first all sit overlapping at the hub spot and bounce out all at once

options.count: Number of basic shape objects, default 34 — image board ([data-fx-part=card]) is added separately
options.zoom: Camera zoom divisor — step of 1 = (panel width+height)/2/zoom px, default 4.5
options.drift: Constant spinning force, default .01 (0 means still)
options.decay: Ratio by which the spinning force decays each frame, default .98
options.pulse: Chrome shine speed on white object, default .4
options.pull: Impact near the cursor while pressed (per frame), default 1
options.hold: Wait before showing the canvas (ms), default 0 — the original loader stays up 4 to 6 seconds while downloading dozens of models
options.hubScale: Hub size multiplier, default 1 (.9375 when panel width is under 768)
options.touch: when spin, dragging vertically with a finger on the panel turns the drum instead of the page (touch-action none)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Image block — uses the inner img, or a placeholder carrying data-label if there is none. data-ratio (width/height), data-scale (long-side unit, default 1)
options.[data-fx-part=loader]: (if present) blinks at the center at .2s while loading, then fades out at .5s one second after it is ready

note: Load THREE (global from the 0.141 build/three.min.js) and CANNON (global from cannon-es.min.js) first. The wheel blocks page scroll over the panel and turns the drum, so use it on a hero where the panel covers the whole screen (a page with no scroll). The original GLB model slots are replaced by twenty basic shapes of the same size (funnel, washer, record, pill, stone, brick, octagon band, helmet, speaker, phone, monitor, mushroom, wire ball, balloon, lens, keypad, ring, sneaker, cup, tube), and the original environment photo by a studio strip painted in the skin colors. Colors are read from --kf-surface (white objects · background), --kf-raised, --kf-dim, --kf-ink, --kf-accent, --kf-accent-text. When frame time runs long, resolution drops by .2 each step (the original adaptive DPR).

from.where: index.html Hero — original react-three-fiber + @react-three/cannon (zero gravity · 20 cylinder walls · contact stiffness 1e6 · friction 0 · 5 iterations)
